Demonstrated experience in tracking and using data to innovate, analyze, problem solve, and communicate results and solutions based on data.
Experience working with project/case management systems.
A minimum of 3 years of experience in program coordination, clinic/office management or a related professional services environment.
Experience planning and executing events such as conferences and workshops.
This is a part-time position (up to 16 hours/week).

Under the general direction of the Faculty Director, the Accounting and Taxation Clinic Coordinator manages the development and administration of an Accounting and Taxation Clinic that supports industry alliance programs/projects and provides pro bono accounting and taxation support to local private businesses, enhances student professional development, and supports the Merage School’s Private Business Initiative. Supports the creation and modification of Clinic policies, procedures, and infrastructure, manages clinic communications with clients, the public, advisory boards, and CPA firm mentors, and plans and/or coordinates Clinic activities and educational conferences. Responsible for managing the Clinic website and student and client application process. Manages development and issuance of engagement letters and the staffing of client engagements with student teams and CPA mentors. Oversees the day-to-day operation and administrative management for the Clinic, including activities that enhance visibility, stakeholder engagement, and program effectiveness.
You'll be a great fit if you have experience with the following:
Managed a client-facing program or clinic, overseeing multiple concurrent engagements
Established and maintained productive relationships with professional stakeholders, advisory boards, or external partners
Created and maintained process documentation while independently managing end-to-end administrative workflows
Planned, coordinated, and executed professional events — such as conferences or workshops — from inception to completion with minimal oversight
Hybrid position with some onsite work expected each week while Clinic is in session.
Ability to perform all commonly applicable functions in common word processing, presentation, and spreadsheet software and web applications.
Demonstrates ability to develop and update process and procedure manuals and manage client application and vetting processes effectively.

Demonstrated professionalism, interpersonal, and communication skills. Ability to develop working relationships within department, among campus staff and faculty, and with industry partners. Demonstrated customer service orientation.
Demonstrates knowledge of industry alliance and client service concepts and practices.
Proven organizational skills and the ability to effectively manage time and prioritize tasks. Takes initiative.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with faculty, staff, and industry professionals and effectively support administrative needs of volunteer CPA mentors and Faculty Director.
Willingness to research and gain a basic understanding of the accounting profession and typical types of engagements serviced by accountants/CPAs.
